entries.notes: R44 audit: どれ as a pronoun meaning “which one,” どの before a noun, どこ for place, and どちら for polite direction/place/selection are accurately distinguished. No factual correction required.
R44 audit: なぜ and どうして both ask for reason/cause; the stated register and conversational nuance distinction is appropriately non-absolute. No factual correction required.

R44 audit: 何 is correctly described as “what,” with なに/なん readings dependent on the following construction; examples with です, particles, time and counters are consistent with instructional references. No factual correction required.

R44 audit: あそこ is correctly treated as the place demonstrative generally distant from both speaker and listener in the ここ・そこ・あそこ・どこ series, with appropriate particle examples and distinction from あちら. No factual correction required.
R44 audit: あちら is correctly described as the polite/directional member of こちら・そちら・あちら・どちら, usable for direction/place and polite person reference. No factual correction required.
